name: Aristotle
q: All men by nature desire to know.
Poetry is finer and more philosophical than history.
The law is reason free from passion.
Character is the most effective means of persuasion.
Virtue is a mean between excess and deficiency.
To be angry with the right person is not easy.
Virtue is a state of character concerned with choice.
Plato is dear, but dearer still is truth.
Man is by nature a political animal.
One swallow does not make a spring
We become brave by doing brave acts
No one chooses to live without friends
Happiness is a kind of activity: living well and doing well
Whoever can live in solitude is either a beast or a god
